environment: Vercel Preview, IAD region, KV East-1

GET /api/research?action=list-runs.notes: Read-only KV scan. Cold cache ~600ms; warm ~80ms.

GET /api/research?action=load-comparison.notes: Read + envelope sanitization. Larger payload than list-runs.

POST /api/research?action=save-audit-run.notes: Write to KV. Limited to 256KB envelope.

POST /api/research?action=save-compariso.notes: Write + identity merge. Bottleneck is identity resolution.

regressionGate.policy: Reject PR when measured p95 exceeds baseline by >25% OR error rate exceeds 2% absolute.
